description: The Rewiring America Incentives API contains structured United States home-electrification incentive rules and code that calculates which programmes may apply to a user. Its README documents a hosted endpoint requiring an API key, local Node development and a database build using geographic and income data. Users provide location, household and project details; outputs are matching rebates or tax-credit descriptions under the encoded rules. Geographic coverage is US federal, state, utility and local programmes present in the service. GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing for repository code; live API access requires registration and incentive rules can have separate source terms. A limitation is that eligibility changes with law, funding and utility area; an API result is not a final legal determination or guaranteed payment. The service can parameterise adoption or retrofit cost scenarios for buildings and electricity networks. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model optimises energy pathways but does not encode household incentives. No user data, API key or service database was downloaded.
name: Rewiring America electrification incentives API
notes: G7 G7-1768. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. Hosted API requires a key; repository and its documentation were public.
